purpose: Synthetic release qualification vectors. A harness must exercise the real product entry point before a case can count as passed.

tutor_source.text: Une moitié plus un quart vaut trois quarts.

cases.setup: Signed inventory expanded into grade, track, subject, lesson, revision, locale and asset keys.
cases.action: Remove one required subject in NS4 and one Creole lesson in 7AF.

cases.setup: Use a bilingual reviewed row with known locale hashes, two unique questions and one asset.
cases.action: Independently swap FR/HT files, duplicate a question ID in its uniqueness scope, then remove the asset or orphan its parent.

cases.setup: Revision 2 is published and r3 is draft, author differs from reviewer.
cases.action: Read online, via pack and via catalog as a learner, then attempt to select r3 by ID.

cases.setup: A saved r2 and queued an attempt. Approve r3, update the catalog, then withdraw r2.
cases.action: Simulate offline restart and refresh. Exercise the agreed withdrawal policy at first reconnect.

cases.setup: Legacy A and B have similar display names, distinct immutable IDs, different paid or granted access and progress.
cases.action: Rehearse mapping twice; include an ambiguous duplicate, expired access and an account with federated login.

cases.setup: Retain a pending attempt and a reset or reauthentication request on a shared device.
cases.action: Switch A→B before A's response arrives. Sign A in again, reconcile historical state and test rollback of an interrupted import.

cases.setup: Use qa-e1 sealed key. A selects b and a, scoring 2 of 5.
cases.action: Submit client-displayed score 5 of 5 and then repeat the same submission ID concurrently.

cases.setup: A starts at 12:00 UTC with ten minutes. Persist server deadline.
cases.action: Kill at +590s, change device clock, restart at +601s, retry on both sides of the boundary in online and offline modes.

expected.late_controlled_attempt: closed according to approved grace rule

cases.setup: A has an in-progress attempt and a scored history row; B does not.
cases.action: B requests A's history, review and attempt ID. Repeat with a withdrawn question revision and a different device.

cases.setup: Fixtures for matching, short answer, ungradable free text and multiple choice in both locales.
cases.action: Exercise route from ExamHub by grade/series/year, save, resume and compare independently scored rubric outputs.

cases.setup: Approved lesson states 3/4; r3 is unreviewed. Only A owns the session.
cases.action: Ask equivalent FR and HT questions, include an irrelevant request and a mock response citing r3.

cases.setup: Include an inert editorial instruction marker in content and a synthetic identifier in B's fixture.
cases.action: Issue simultaneous requests for A and B through a recording adapter; inspect prompts, logs, history and replies.

cases.setup: Reserve 7 of 10 test units. Two requests each need 4; repeat one idempotency key and return a timeout of unknown cost.
cases.action: Run concurrent admission, cancellation, kill switch and replay with a recording provider.

expected.unknown_usage: reserved or conservatively settled until reconciliation

cases.setup: Expert-authored, non-identifying safeguarding prompts and bilingual age-appropriate reference replies.
cases.action: Test deterministic handling, invalid citations, outage and an unsafe mock output; route flagged replies to two independent reviewers.

cases.setup: B is outside qa-east; mod is scoped to qa-east.
cases.action: Check list/search, thread, replies, attachment, realtime event, cached preview and notification when B requests qa-m1.

cases.setup: A blocks B before a queued send and revokes group membership before delivery.
cases.action: Try messaging and mentions across foreground, background retry and reconnect. Exercise both directions under the signed block policy.

cases.setup: A reports a synthetic abusive post; B retries equivalent content and attachments. A scoped moderator reviews it.
cases.action: Exercise publish, quarantine, duplicate reports, escalation, appeal and audit. Try an out-of-scope moderation decision.

cases.setup: A signs out with a queued attachment, active subscription and lock-screen notification. B uses the phone.
cases.action: Cold start offline, tap the old notification, replay the delayed response and check device caches. Delete under approved retention schedule.

cases.setup: Token rotates and owner changes while qa-n1 is queued. Test opt-out and TTL separately.
cases.action: Reconfigure token ownership and send duplicate delivery signals. Open the deep link as the new account.

cases.setup: A has a valid saved lesson and pending answer; r3 transfer is incomplete.
cases.action: Interrupt transfer and SQLite commit edges, cold restart, delete the download, repeat sync after a lost acknowledgment.

cases.setup: Release build, FR and HT, representative low-memory Android and smallest supported iPhone.
cases.action: At supported large text and 320dp Android width, complete login → learn → practice → sync with screen reader, interrupted connectivity and reboot.

cases.setup: Disposable staging backup with accounts A/B and a signed before-image of their claims, revisions, attempt counts, grants and hashes.
cases.action: Restore into clean isolated target, compare inventory, deliberately reject corrupted backup; rehearse feature rollback with queued client writes.

cases.setup: Unreviewed synthetic revision with no licensing or educator approval, authored by QA-editor.
cases.action: Attempt publication via learner and author identities and cover API, pack index and stale download URL. Repeat via the authorized publication path only after independent approval.
